name: Resource Monitor
author: brunonlinespace
description: Read-only live CPU, memory, disk and network monitor with configurable provider-backed Overview cards, movable/persistently lockable resource tabs, Quadrants/Strips Overview layout, Linux-native deep Processes/Physical Memory views, additive provenance-coloured optional privilege, standard Helper/Sources/About Options, and a parallel detailed TUI.

capabilities.label: Process file-descriptor targets
capabilities.standard: Readable for processes permitted by the current user and Linux /proc access controls.
capabilities.elevated: The fixed root helper can enumerate file-descriptor targets for otherwise restricted processes.

capabilities.label: Process mapped module/file paths
capabilities.standard: Mapped files/modules are visible only where ordinary process-map access is permitted.
capabilities.elevated: The fixed root helper can enumerate mapped module/file paths for otherwise restricted processes.

capabilities.label: Selected-process memory attribution and map
capabilities.standard: smaps_rollup and smaps are read only when Linux permits the current user to inspect the selected process.
capabilities.elevated: The fixed root helper can read only the selected PID smaps_rollup/smaps data when ordinary access is restricted.

capabilities.label: System socket ownership visibility
capabilities.standard: Socket/process ownership is reported where psutil and ordinary /proc visibility permit it.
capabilities.elevated: The fixed root helper can correlate system socket inodes with process file descriptors across restricted processes.
